cleaner.label: Go cache
cleaner.description: Go build cache and downloaded modules, rebuildable. Does not touch GOPATH\bin or your sources.

option.label: Go build cache
option.description: Removes the Go build cache. Wait for running builds to finish; later builds will take longer.

option.label: Go downloaded modules
option.description: Removes the module cache (pkg\mod): sources and archives of downloaded modules. Cache files are read-only; cleaning removes them anyway.
option.warning: Modules are re-downloaded on the next `go build` or `go mod download`: network required. Cache files are read-only.
